## Versions and environment
Extension commit/version, TRex base, AWS-LC/nghttp2, OS/compiler, NIC/PMD/NUMA.

## Reproducer
Minimal sanitized profile, exact command and expected behavior.

## Actual behavior
Errors, completion counts, active flows, retransmits and relevant logs.

## Checks performed
Did clean application and source-hash verification pass? Is this reproducible
without a DUT, and on the previous release? Do not attach private keys.
